about: 일별이익현황 원가 [선입선출(판매)](원본 기본값, 2026-10-04 실측) — 회사 전체 품목별 FIFO. 2개 @1,000 · 2개 @1,500 을 사고 3개를 팔면 원가 2×1,000 + 1×1,500 = 3,500. 판매를 고쳐도(원복 줄이 생겨도) 같은 값, 판매를 지우면 층이 돌아와 다시 팔면 같은 값. 품목은 QA2FIFO01(재고 이력 때문에 못 지워 다시 쓴다). 만든 전표는 지운다.

shots.name: 구매 2@1,000 · 2@1,500 → 판매 3 → FIFO 원가 3,500 → 판매 수정해도 3,500 → 화면 기본 원가가 선입선출(판매)
steps: js:(async () => { const A = (m, u, b) => fetch('/api' + u, { method: m, headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => (r.status === 204 ? null : r.json())); const [pa, it, wh] = await Promise.all([A('GET', '/partners'), A('GET', '/items'), A('GET', '/warehouses')]); const base = it[0]; const item = it.find((x) => x.code === 'QA2FIFO01') ?? await A('POST', '/items', { code: 'QA2FIFO01', name: 'QA재고2-선입선출', unit: 'EA', category: base.category, unitPrice: 0, safetyStock: 0 }); const d = new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const c = pa[0], w = wh[0]; const before = (await A('GET', '/stock')).filter((x) => x.itemId === item.id).reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.quantity), 0); const p1 = await A('POST', '/purchases', { partnerId: c.id, warehouseId: w.id, purchaseDate: d, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: item.id, quantity: 2, unitPrice: 1000 }] }); const p2 = await A('POST', '/purchases', { partnerId: c.id, warehouseId: w.id, purchaseDate: d, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: item.id, quantity: 2, unitPrice: 1500 }] }); const s = await A('POST', '/sales', { partnerId: c.id, warehouseId: w.id, saleDate: d, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: item.id, quantity: 3, unitPrice: 5000 }] }); sessionStorage.setItem('fifo', JSON.stringify({ item: item.id, p1: p1.id, p2: p2.id, s: s.id, no: s.docNo, d, c: c.id, w: w.id, before })); return '재고(전) ' + before + ' 판매 ' + s.docNo })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fifo')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const r = (await (await fetch('/api/stock/fifo-sale-costs?to=' + x.d, { headers: H })).json()).find((y) => y.docNo === x.no && y.itemId === x.item); sessionStorage.setItem('fifo1', JSON.stringify(r)); return x.before === 0 ? Number(r.cost) === 3500 && Number(r.quantity) === 3 : !!r })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fifo')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; await fetch('/api/sales/' + x.s, { method: 'PUT', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ partnerId: x.c, warehouseId: x.w, saleDate: x.d, remark: 'QA재고2 수정', lines: [{ itemId: x.item, quantity: 3, unitPrice: 6000 }] }) }); const r = (await (await fetch('/api/stock/fifo-sale-costs?to=' + x.d, { headers: H })).json()).find((y) => y.docNo === x.no && y.itemId === x.item); const first = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fifo1')); return Number(r.cost) === Number(first.cost) && Number(r.quantity) === 3 })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fifo')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const a = await fetch('/api/sales/' + x.s, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const b = await fetch('/api/purchases/' + x.p2, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const c = await fetch('/api/purchases/' + x.p1, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return a.status === 204 && b.status === 204 && c.status === 204 })()
